steps.text: Talk to Olaf Hradson north east of Rellekka.
Chop a log from the Windswept Tree east of Olaf.
Bring the logs to Olaf Hradson north east of Rellekka.
Talk to Ingrid Hradson near the well in southeast Rellekka.
Talk to Volf Olafson north of the longhall in Rellekka.
Return to Olaf Hradson north east of Rellekka.
Use the damp planks on Olaf's embers.
Talk to Olaf again, and give him some food.
choices: Alright, here, have some food. Now give me the map.

steps.text: Dig next to the Windswept Tree.
Pick up the dropped key.
Go deeper into the caverns and kill a Skeleton Fremennik for a key.
Search the picture wall in the north room.
Pick up 2 rotten barrels and 6 ropes from around the room.
Pick up 1 rotten barrels and 3 ropes from around the room.
WALK onto the walkway to the east, and use a barrel on it to repair it.
WALK on the walkway and repair the next hole in it.
Open the gate on the walkway, clicking the key hole which matches your key.
Click the square key hole.
Click the cross key hole.
Click the triangle key hole.
Click the circle key hole.
Click the star key hole.
WALK off the remaining walkway, and search the chest in the wreck. Be prepared to fight Ulfric.
Kill Ulfric.
Search the chest again to finish the quest.
Click the highlighted boxes to turn the squares to solve the puzzle.

rewards: Access to Brine Rats and the ability to receive them as a slayer task.
